scope: One timed subscription availability probe on the existing Sol machine; no mathematical work or final data.

parameters.passive_wait_note: Timeout includes sleep until the reset hint plus a bounded five-minute probe; waiting consumes no model calls.

validation_commands: import json; p=json.load(open('audit/SOL-010/availability.json',encoding='utf-8')); assert p['usable'] and p['exit_code']==0 and p['response'].strip()=='SAFEINVEST_SOL_AVAILABLE'; assert p['model_calls']==1 and p['model']=='gpt-6.1-sol'
acceptance_checks: Exact immutable task, pinned base, canonical source/artifact hashes and real successful command exits.
Report timestamps are no earlier than 2026-10-20T01:05:00+08:00 and response is exactly SAFEINVEST_SOL_AVAILABLE with model exit code zero.
No account/model changes, purchases, model retry loop or mathematical recomputation; one actual model response on the assigned machine.
A successful probe proves access only at its time, not sufficient budget for subsequent reviews. Chief alone may release SOL-008/009 after validating the exact receipt.
instructions: Run only the prescribed commands with the existing Python 3.12 environment and existing Codex login. This commands task is deliberately not an agent task: the script waits without model calls until the specified reset hint, then makes exactly one read-only no-tools response request to the assigned Sol model. Do not rerun failed reviews, change models/accounts, buy credits, remove worktrees, alter any published task or open final data. The longer wall timeout allows passive waiting; model time is capped at five minutes. Preserve failed report/logs and let the runner publish failure. No automatic retry inside this attempt. Parent runner handles commit/push. A success is current access evidence only; the coordinator verifies it before releasing existing immutable review holds.
